text: The first notice of the fraudulent debt was through a collection action on my credit report. I have received no other notices of this debt, which is fraudulent debt. The collection agency MRS BPO filed the collection action with the credit bureaus, but the debt originated with XXXX XXXX XXXX. I havent done business with XXXX XXXX XXXX for over 10 years. I have received nothing from XXXX XXXX XXXX or MRS BPO notifying me of this account or debt prior to it appearing on my credit report. How is this possible that a derogatory comment can be added to my report without some evidence that an attempt to collect the debt from my valid mailing address, email address or phone number has been made? This isnt consumer protection. As stated, I have not received any notice in any form about this debt nor did I enter into any business agreement with XXXX XXXX XXXX. About the time this fraudulent debt was incurred, XX/XX/2023, an erroneous new address was added to my XXXX credit report. I immediately notified them that the address was not valid now or at any time.

meta.issue: Attempts to collect debt not owed
